name: match-normal-tap-pvp-01
note: PVP-01: A taps a normal cell -> turnsUsed A 1, turn passes to B.

name: match-bomb-gives-two-turns-pvp-03
note: PVP-03: A hits a bomb (skip A = 1, turn to B). After B's turn the loop sees skip A > 0: A's turn is skipped (turnsUsed A 2), B moves again. After B's second turn A moves: order B, B, A.

name: match-mutual-bombs-cancel-pvp-04
note: PVP-04: A bomb (skip A 1) -> B. B bomb (skip B 1): next = A, skip A -> 0 (A 2), next = B, skip B -> 0 (B 2), next = A -> A moves. Mutual skips cancel.

name: match-timeout-pvp-05
note: PVP-05: A times out -> turn counted (A 1), timeouts in a row 1, turn to B.

name: match-three-timeouts-afk-pvp-06
note: PVP-06: the third timeout in a row of A -> B wins, reason afk.

name: match-move-resets-timeouts-pvp-07
note: PVP-07: two timeouts, then a move in time resets the counter to 0.

name: match-final-turn-pvp-09
note: PVP-09: A finds the 2nd target with turnsUsed A 2 > B 1 and skip B 0 -> finalTurn, current B.

name: match-final-turn-draw-pvp-10
note: PVP-10: in finalTurn B finds its last target -> draw (winner null), reason targets.

name: match-final-turn-miss-pvp-11
note: PVP-11: in finalTurn B misses -> A wins.

name: match-final-turn-bomb-pvp-11
note: PVP-11: in finalTurn B hits a bomb -> A wins (the final turn is over).

name: match-final-turn-timeout-pvp-11
note: PVP-11: in finalTurn B times out -> A wins.

name: match-second-player-wins-at-once-pvp-12
note: PVP-12: B (second) finds the last target with turnsUsed B 2 = A 2 -> no final turn, B wins immediately.

name: match-skip-eats-final-turn-pvp-13
note: PVP-13: B's bomb skip. A target (A 1), B bomb (B 1, skip B 1), A target (A 2, all found): turnsUsed B 1 < 2 but skip B > 0 -> skip consumed (B 2) -> A wins at once.

name: match-turn-limit-winner-pvp-14
note: PVP-14 with maxTurns 2: both reach 2 turns; A found 1, B 0 -> A wins, reason turnLimit.

name: match-turn-limit-draw-pvp-14
note: PVP-14 with maxTurns 2: equal targets -> draw, reason turnLimit.

name: match-surrender-pvp-15
note: PVP-15: B surrenders at any moment -> A wins, reason surrender.

name: match-two-bombs-in-a-row
note: Part 1 §5.4: two bombs on two own turns = two skips. A bomb -> B, B (A skipped); A bomb again -> B, B.

name: match-first-player-b
note: The first player is B (server draw): B moves first.

name: match-turn-limit-40-b-wins-pvp-14
note: PVP-14 at the real limit: B finds 1 target, then 40 turns each -> B wins, turnLimit.

name: match-turn-limit-40-draw-pvp-14
note: PVP-14: one target each, 40 turns each -> draw, turnLimit.

name: match-bomb-on-last-turn-pvp-14
note: A hits a bomb on its 40th turn: the skip is never used, B plays its 40th turn -> turnLimit draw.

name: match-targets-on-turn-40-final-turn
note: A finds the last target on its 40th turn: the target check comes before the turn limit -> finalTurn for B (39 turns).

name: match-final-turn-on-turn-40-draw
note: B finds its last target in the final turn at 40/40 -> draw by targets, not turnLimit.

name: match-second-player-wins-on-turn-40
note: B finds the last target on its 40th turn, A also has 40 -> B wins by targets at once.

name: match-final-turn-partial-target-pvp-11
note: PVP-11: in the final turn B finds a target but not the last one -> A wins.

name: match-single-target-first-turn-pvp-09
note: PVP-09 with one target: A finds it on turn 1 -> finalTurn for B.

name: match-second-player-wins-with-pending-skip-pvp-12
note: A hits a bomb (skip pending), B finds its only target: B has as many turns as A -> B wins at once, the skip is irrelevant.

name: match-first-b-bomb-pvp-03
note: PVP-03 with B first: B hits a bomb -> A, A, then B.

name: match-b-afk-pvp-06
note: PVP-06 for B: three B timeouts in a row -> A wins, afk.

name: match-bomb-resets-timeouts-pvp-07
note: A bomb is a move made in time: it resets the timeout row; skipped turns do not count as timeouts.

name: match-afk-after-opponent-bomb-pvp-17
note: PVP-17: A keeps timing out while B hits a bomb -> the third A timeout ends the match, afk.

name: match-surrender-before-first-turn-pvp-15
note: PVP-15: B surrenders before any turn -> A wins.

name: match-surrender-off-turn-pvp-15
note: PVP-15: A surrenders during B's turn -> B wins.

name: match-surrender-in-final-turn
note: B surrenders in its final turn -> A wins, surrender.

name: match-finisher-surrenders-in-final-turn
note: A (who found all targets) surrenders during B's final turn -> B wins, surrender (surrender always loses).

name: match-afk-in-final-turn
note: B times out a third time in a row in its final turn -> A wins with reason afk (the AFK check comes first in endTurn; decision 0008 #14).

name: match-skip-reaches-turn-limit
note: B hits a bomb on its 39th turn; A plays its 40th, B's skip takes B to 40 -> the match ends at once by turnLimit, A gets no 41st turn (decision 0008 #15).
